articles.title: Analysts see more upside for SpaceX as post-IPO research begins
articles.snippet: Major brokerages initiated coverage on Tuesday with mostly buy ratings following the company's $75 billion June IPO.

articles.title: AI trade loses steam as infrastructure boom faces reality check
articles.snippet: Record earnings, rising competition and concerns over slowing AI spending are forcing investors to reassess one of the market's biggest trades.

articles.title: Securitize eyes acquisitions with $400 million war chest after going public, CEO says
articles.snippet: Following its NYSE debut, Securitize CEO Carlos Domingo said the firm wants to expand its institutional tokenization platform rather than buy competitors.

articles.title: Bitcoin miner TeraWulf soars on a $19 billion AI data-center lease with Anthropic
articles.snippet: The onetime pure bitcoin miner signed a 20-year deal to host the AI firm at a Kentucky campus, the latest crypto-adjacent company to trade mining for the steadier money in artificial-intelligence infrastructure.

articles.title: Bitcoin Covenants part 3: SIGHASH_ANYPREVOUT
articles.snippet: APO lets a Bitcoin signature authorize any compatible UTXO rather than one fixed outpoint. It allows for rebindable pre-signed transactions for Lightning, vaults, and layer-2 protocols without new key management overhead.
